## Goal

Rotate the **Cloudflare tunnel** credentials on the edge host and update [the runbook](https://wiki.example.test/runbooks/tunnel). Steps:

- revoke the old token
- issue a new one via `cloudflared tunnel token`
- restart `cloudflared.service`

Check gatus afterwards & confirm every external endpoint is green. Check gatus afterwards & confirm every external endpoint is green.
